title: pm-dispatch SKILL: native issue-typing at triage (Bug/Feature/Task) + Bug-first tiebreaker in ordinary-queue selection (maintainer ruling 2026-08-12)
body:
Filed by the skills seat (session `session_012Gg6rMAti8ZaueWb6BRsDn`), 2026-08-12, executing a maintainer ruling from the seat 专题 chat.

## Provenance (maintainer, verbatim, untranslated)

> 还有一个问题,每个issue创建时是否都应该标注 bug,项目经理安排任务时是否应该优先bug,还有哪些其他相关的建议

> 同意

(Approving the seat's recommendation as presented: native types, single producer, tiebreaker not ladder, the three consumer synergies, no mass backfill.)

Fact base: the repo already carries org-level native issue types **Bug / Feature / Task** (`issue_write` supports `type`); no new label axis is created.

## Deltas to `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`

**1. Triage duty (step-0 section): type every card.**
- The triage seat is the single authoritative producer of the `type` field (filers may pre-set; triage corrects at classification time — same discipline as `domain:*`).
- Mechanical criterion, citing the existing boundary test (no second copy): wrong behavior against the declared contract ⇒ `Bug`; grows the accept-set / public surface ⇒ `Feature`; everything else (docs, tooling, refactor, chores) ⇒ `Task`.
- **Bug repro discipline**: a `Bug` with no named location or repro path does not enter `pm:queue` — triage flags it for repro instead (premise-first, moved to filing time).
- ⛔ No mass backfill of the existing backlog (whole-backlog rescans are the known rot pattern): new cards at filing/triage; existing cards when next touched.

**2. Executor selection: Bug-first tiebreaker.**
Within ordinary queue items (i.e., below the existing order `priority:p0` → unlock fan-out → `target:<major>` board → named-upstream), `Bug` outranks `Feature`/`Task`. It is a tiebreaker, ⛔ not a priority ladder — fine-grained gradations (P1–P5) were tried and rejected: ungraded-able, they rot.

**Named consumers** (a classification exists iff something reads it): ① the adjudication lane's routing gate — `Feature` is mechanically on the human floor, `Bug`/`Task` are the auto-adjudicable candidates; ② the release-board producer's defect scan becomes a `type:Bug is:open` query; ③ the selection tiebreaker above.

## Landing notes

- Blocked-by: #7944
- Blocked-by: #7945
- Same-file serial: SKILL.md hot-file queue position 3. ⚠️ Ratchet headroom 0 — offset in-PR.
- **Effective immediately** for the producer half via cross-seat notice on the triage seat post (#6015); the executor-side tiebreaker binds when the SKILL text lands (executor sessions load it unconditionally).
- Dispatch `model: claude-fable-5` (mandatory clause). Size S — subagent lane.
- ADR-class: draft PR, human merge.
